task: Review every supplied part, discover the most consequential events from the supplied evidence, cluster related reports, assign the best-fit broad news category dynamically and produce up to 150 processed stories using schema/processed-news.schema.json. items.title: When childhood feels unsafe: POCSO cases in A.P.’s Rayalseema
items.summary: Rayalaseema’s POCSO cases reveal a troubling mix of vulnerability, silence and delayed intervention, even as police investigations become more technology-driven, reports K. Umashanker. Andhra Pradesh recorded a decline in cases in 2025, but Chittoor saw a rise while Anantapur and Kurnool recorded falls. With 5,408 cases pending in exclusive POCSO courts, forensic delays, staff shortages, stigma and fear continue to test the promise of speedy justice, while experts stress prevention, early reporting and stronger child-protection systems.
